entities.summary: Henri Eugène Philippe Louis d'Orléans, Duke of Aumale was a leader of the Orleanists, a political faction in 19th-century France associated with constitutional monarchy. He was born in Paris, the fifth son of King Louis-Philippe I of the French and Maria Amalia of Naples and Sicily and used the title Duke of Aumale. Henri d'Orléans, Duke of Aumale was a journalists & chroniclers from Paris (1822-01-16, Paris–1897-05-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
